One day, after The New Cyclops Serial Killings was resolved, internet idol Iris Sagan (known as "A-set") is abducted by a UFO and forced to participate in a perilous escape game called The Third Eye Game. It's up to Special Agent Kaname Date and his AI-ball partner Aiba to track down the UFO and rescue Iris from this dangerous game.

No Sleep For Kaname Date From - AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES incorporates a new "Escape" gameplay segments along with familiar "Investigation" and "Somnium" gameplay segments.
